description: Prochains passages des lignes de bus du réseau STAR en temps réel is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des prochains passages aux points d'arrêts sur les lignes de bus du réseau STAR en temps réel, comprenant notamment l'heure de départ et l'heure d'arrivée. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are bus, temps réel. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2014-11-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
